scenes.title: Your First Python Program
scenes.caption: Write a line. Run it. Observe what happens.
scenes.prompt: What message do you expect to see?

scenes.title: Python Can Calculate
scenes.caption: print() can display text and calculation results.

scenes.title: Numbers and Text
scenes.caption: Quotation marks tell Python that a value is text.

scenes.title: Matching Quotation Marks
scenes.errorPrompt: SyntaxError: string is missing a closing quote
scenes.caption: The opening and closing quotation marks must match.

scenes.title: Comments Are Notes
code: # This is a note for people
scenes.caption: Comments begin with # and do not appear in program output.

scenes.title: Make the Message Personal
scenes.caption: A variable stores a value that the program can use.
scenes.prompt: Notice the f prefix and the curly braces.

scenes.title: Your Turn
scenes.caption: Change the name, predict the result, and run your code.
scenes.prompt: Replace Alex with your own name.

scenes.title: Fix One Thing at a Time
scenes.errorPrompt: SyntaxError: string is missing a closing quote
scenes.caption: Read the error. Check the line. Change one thing. Run again.

scenes.title: What You Have Learned
scenes.caption: You wrote code, ran it, observed the result, and made a change.
